skill.name: Technical Debt
skill.description: Reckless versus prudent categorization, tracking the inventory, and a payoff cadence that does not freeze delivery.
skill.summary: Quadrant that matters is reckless vs prudent; bugs and missing features are not debt. Each item carries interest (carry = time lost x frequency), blast radius (local vs structural), payoff cost (refactor + regression). Pay when fix cost < ~2-3x one quarter's carry. Amortize ~15-25% of capacity per sprint; debt sprints confess failed amortization. Default refactor; strangler fig for wrong seams.
